# Sotto Voce

> Sotto Voce is a private dictation keyboard and speech-to-text app for iPhone, made by Daniel Li. Speech is transcribed on the iPhone itself, by Apple's on-device speech recogniser: audio is never uploaded or saved, it works offline once its models have downloaded, and there is no account. It types into any app, learns the owner's voice from one sentence so it leaves out other people talking nearby, and includes a full keyboard with autocorrect and emoji search. Free for 1,000 words a week; Sotto Voce Pro removes the limit for £2.99 a month, £19.99 a year or £74.99 once ($2.99, $19.99 or $79.99 in the US). Requires iOS 26. English.

- [Homepage](https://sottovoce.uk/): what it does, privacy, the keyboard, pricing and an FAQ
- [Sotto Voce vs Wispr Flow](https://sottovoce.uk/vs-wispr-flow.html): a sourced side-by-side, including where Wispr Flow is the better choice
- [Support](https://sottovoce.uk/support.html): setting up the keyboard, Full Access, learning your voice, turning the microphone off, Pro
- [Privacy policy](https://sottovoce.uk/privacy.html)
